title: VerifyResult
description: The output of `dyno verify`: whether a receipt holds, and each check that says so.

checks.description:
Every check, in the order of [`VerifyCheckId`]. A check that a flag did not ask for is
there too, as `not_checked`.

key.description: The key that signed the receipt. Null when no given key did.

reason.description: Why the receipt is not verified: the first check that did not match. Null when it is.

receipt.description:
What the lab signed: the issuer, the time, the device and its readings. Null unless the
signature matched, because dyno does not repeat a claim that nobody signed.

verified.description:
True when a given key signed the receipt, and nothing that was checked differs from it.
The exit code comes from it alone.

Receipt.description:
What a lab signs: which result it stands behind, for which build, on which device, and the
device's readings.

build_id.description: The build id of the files the lab ran: 64 lower-case hex characters.

check_id.description: The lab's id for the run.

dyno_version.description: The dyno version that made the result.

issued_at.description: When the lab signed: RFC 3339, in UTC, to the second, ending in `Z`.

issuer.description: The lab's name, such as a domain.

key_id.description:
Which of the lab's keys signed: the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the raw
32-byte public key.

protocol.description:
How the lab ran the check: the host profile's name and version, the scenario, the spins
and the device runs. [`ReceiptProtocol`] is the object that dyno writes. A receipt from
another signer can name its fields in another way, so a reader gets the object as it is.

result_hash.description: The result's own `result_hash`, as the result states it. Null when it states none.

result_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the whole result file.

ReceiptDevice.description: The device that ran the check.

key.description: The device catalogue's key, such as "iphone-14-pro-max".

model.description: The model's name, such as "iPhone 14 Pro Max". Null when the result does not name it.

os_version.description: The OS version, such as "26.6.2 (23G90)". Null when the result does not give it.

ReceiptLab.description: The lab that ran the check.

backend.description:
What the lab's devices run on, such as the name of a device cloud. Null when the lab does
not say.

kind.description: What kind of lab it is, in the lab's own words.

unit.description: The unit, such as "bytes". Null when the signer does not give it.

value.description: The reading, in the measure's unit. Null when the device gave none.

actual.description:
What dyno found in the result, or worked out from the result or the build. Null when it
found none, or did not look.

expected.description: What the receipt states. Null for a check with no value to state.

reason.description: Why the check did not match, or was not made. Null when it matched.

VerifyCheckId.description: The things `dyno verify` checks, in the order it checks them.

oneOf.description: One of the given keys has the receipt's `key_id`.
The signature is that key's, over the receipt.
The lab had not retired the key when it issued the receipt.

`--result`: the SHA-256 of the result file's canonical JSON is the receipt's
`result_sha256`.
`--result`: the result's build id is the receipt's `build_id`.
`--build`: the build id of the files is the receipt's `build_id`.

VerifyKey.description: The key that signed a receipt.

created_at.description: When the lab made the key. Null for a key given with `--key`, which has no times.

retired.description:
Whether the lab has retired the key. A retired key still verifies a receipt that was
issued before `retired_at`.

retired_at.description: When the lab retired the key. Null when it has not, and for a key given with `--key`.

VerifyOutcome.description: The outcome of one check of a receipt.

oneOf.description: No flag asked for the check, or a check before it did not match.
